top_3_pros: [FACT] All major systems (roof, HVAC, water heater, electrical, windows) are 2019 — no near-term capital expenditure risk for 5–10 years
[ESTIMATE] Large 6,045 sqft home on 0.46-acre lot with low $115/month HOA is good value-per-sqft for Loudoun County luxury tier
[FACT] DOM of 2 days means negotiating pressure hasn't built yet — seller may still be optimistic, but CDOM tells a different story
top_3_cons: [ESTIMATE] Asking price is 6.1% ($78,300) above Zestimate of $1,288,700 — seller is overreaching relative to algorithmic market value
[INFERENCE] CDOM of 82 vs DOM of 2 is a textbook relist-to-reset-the-clock tactic; the market has already rejected this property at or near this price for nearly 3 months
[INFERENCE] Rent Zestimate of $3,999/month yields only 3.5% gross annual return on $1.367M — zero investment merit; this is purely a lifestyle buy dependent on appreciation
red_flags: CDOM 82 / DOM 2 mismatch — listing was almost certainly pulled and relisted to hide market time; ask for full MLS history
No county assessed value available — cannot independently benchmark price; this gap should be resolved before making an offer
Zestimate gap of $78,300 without any verified county data to support the premium — seller has no hard anchor for the ask
questions_for_agent: The CDOM shows 82 days but DOM shows 2 — was this listing withdrawn and relisted? What is the full price history since original list date?
Were there any prior contracts or offers that fell through, and if so, what caused them to terminate?
What is the current Loudoun County assessed value, and has the seller received a recent appraisal?
Has the seller made any price reductions from the original list price, and what is their stated motivation for selling a 5-year-old home?
Are there any known HOA litigation, special assessments, or pending community issues in this neighborhood?
step6_ai_interpretation.one_line_summary: Overpriced by ~$78K against Zestimate with 82 cumulative days of market rejection hidden behind a relist — negotiate aggressively toward $1.28–1.30M or walk.
